reason: Both conversations correctly told the homeowner to stop resetting the RCD and get a professional in, but Conversation 2 gave the practically correct isolation advice for a hard-wired built-in oven (switch off at the cooker switch) whereas Conversation 1 said to 'unplug' it. Conversation 2 also asked the two most useful questions - whether it trips immediately or only after heating/on one function, and whether it had been cleaned - which surfaced the grill-vs-fan-oven distinction and the recent oven-spray cleaning, pointing to moisture-related earth leakage in the fan element, and it correctly declined to recommend a part. Its third reply was garbled ('until then' with no referent) and never clearly explained the likely cause or insulation testing, forcing the customer to ask what to do next, which keeps the margin slight; Conversation 1 was clearer and named element insulation breakdown as the likely cause, but asked nothing and simply ended.
